name: Hornworm
look: a fat bright green tobacco hornworm caterpillar with white diagonal side stripes and a curved red tail horn
entry: While most Bug-types avoid Nicotiny, Hornworm devours entire fields of them, storing the bitter alkaloids in its body to deter predators.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Toxin Gourmet heals it instead of hurting it when it is hit by a Poison- or Grass-type move.
